description: Blend a stars-only image into a starless one in place, as a screen blend that turns colour-preserving in bright star cores. The mode follows, per pixel, the star layer's own luminance SL (the mean of its three channels). Below core_threshold_low: per-channel screen blend 1 - (1 - target) * (1 - stars * k). Above core_threshold_high: luminance-only screen blend, the target's colour scaled by the new over the old luminance and capped at max_value. Between them the two blend linearly. k = strength * prot, where prot falls linearly from 1 at core_threshold_low to min_strength_fraction at core_threshold_high. With pre_star_id, the bright-area colour ratios of that view are then restored over the same luminance ramp (see restore_star_color). Runs as 64-bit PixelMath truncated to [0,1]; reports the target's median and max before and after.

core_threshold_high.description: Star luminance SL at and above which the pure colour-preserving blend applies and protection is min_strength_fraction; greater than core_threshold_low

core_threshold_low.description: Star luminance SL at and below which the pure screen blend applies and protection is 1

max_value.description: Upper cap on each channel of the colour-preserving blend, and of the colour restoration when pre_star_id is given

min_strength_fraction.description: Protection factor reached at core_threshold_high (strength is multiplied by it)

pre_star_id.description: Optional: RGB view whose colour ratios are restored in bright areas after the blend; empty or absent = no restoration

strength.description: Multiplier k on the star layer in the screen blend, before protection

target_id.description: Starless RGB view, modified in place

name: star_protected_blend
